what.en: The street address of the building or lease space the Certificate of Occupancy covers itself, with suite or unit. Not a mailing, head-office or overseas address, and not a P.O. box.
what.zh: 填写占用许可证所涵盖的建筑或租赁空间本身的街道地址（含门牌号/单元号）。不能填写邮寄地址、总部地址、海外地址或邮政信箱。

ifNone.en: This line names the US location being permitted, so there is no substitute: secure the lease or site first, then file with that address.
ifNone.zh: 此栏填写的是申请许可的美国经营地点本身，没有替代方案：请先签订租约或确定场地，再用该地址申请。

confirmations.quote: shall not use or change the use of a building, a portion of a building, or land without obtaining a Certificate of Occupancy
A change of use is any proposed change to the use of a property or an intensification of an existing use
a person shall not use or occupy or change the use or occupancy of a building, a portion of a building, or land

notes: The Land Use Questionnaire's only address is the occupied space. Dallas Development Code 51A-1.104 was read through the fetch tool (American Legal blocks direct downloads). The DallasNow application's own owner/applicant addresses have no box on this PDF and are not ruled here.
